page: Amazon Web Services i7ie.48xlarge is a storage-optimized server instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features 192 vCPUs and 96 physical cores from an Intel Xeon 8559C processor operating at 3.2 GHz. The system is equipped with 1536.0 GB of DDR5 memory running at 6 GHz, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, the instance includes 120000 GB of NVMe SSD capacity. Network connectivity is supported by a 100 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance across multiple categories. The multi-core CPU performance via stress-ng and the Passmark CPU score both rank in the top 10% tier. Memory bandwidth for both small cached blocks and large uncached blocks also falls into the top 10% tier. Database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving throughput similarly achieve top-tier results. However, single-core CPU performance and Passmark memory scores are positioned in the average tier.

The hardware profile offers high resource density, combining massive local NVMe SSD storage with a high-capacity DDR5 memory array. This configuration provides qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring local data persistence and high-throughput processing without the need for external storage attachments. The presence of Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions supports workloads like LLM inference, where prompt processing for large models and text generation for medium models reach top-tier speeds. This server is suited for large-scale databases, data warehousing, high-throughput web serving, and memory-intensive analytical processing.
